title_en: The Stance of Sunni Scholars on the Hadith of Al-Atit
description_en: The stance of Sunni scholars on the hadith of al-atit. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: An overview of how Sunni scholars view and interpret the hadith concerning the creaking sound of the Throne (al-atit).
